Bacon: two strips, each roughly 300 px long (about 15 cm) and 50 px wide (about 2.5 cm). Cooked bacon is thin, so each strip is around 12 g, giving about 25 g total.

Egg whites: a scattered pile of white curds with some orange sauce, covering about 150 x 130 px (roughly 7 x 6 cm) with a height of about 2 cm. That comes to around 60 g. Hot sauce adds a little, but I'll fold it into the egg item.
